sdlcOverview.pipeline: Requirements -> Architecture -> Threat Model -> Specification -> Implementation -> Verification -> Release & Maintenance
sdlcOverview.summary: Universal AI SDLC installs into its own isolated plugin directory and initializes a single .sdlc/ folder inside each project you onboard, leaving your app source code clean.

addons.name: Core ICM Governance & Specs
addons.sdlcRole: Provides the 7-stage folder structure (.sdlc/), traceable REQ->ADR->THR->SPEC->PROOF contracts, proof-auditor, MCP ledger, and add-on manager.
addons.benefit: Keeps requirements, decisions, and verification proof organized on disk so AI agents and humans share one verifiable source of truth.

addons.name: EGM No-Code Design Gate
addons.sdlcRole: Blocks premature coding by requiring trade-off analysis, system boundaries, and a fresh-context review via the read-only arch-reviewer subagent.
addons.benefit: Catches hidden assumptions, vague specs, and architectural blind spots before writing code, reducing costly rewrites.

addons.name: Graphify Context Intelligence
addons.sdlcRole: Queries graphify-out/ knowledge graphs first (with EXTRACTED/INFERRED confidence tags) and falls back cleanly to targeted static search when absent.
addons.benefit: Maps cross-module dependencies and blast radius with far fewer wasted tokens and clearer impact visibility.

addons.name: Threat Modeling & Profile Gates
addons.sdlcRole: Enforces pre-code threat models, read-only security-reviewer audits, and profile-scaled verification gates (web, API, mobile, desktop, game).
addons.benefit: Catches auth, secret, and injection gaps before implementation and right-sizes security checks to your stack.

addons.name: Maintenance, Drift & Evolution
addons.sdlcRole: Enforces repro-first bug fixes, spec-to-code drift detection, and promotion of recurring mistakes into permanent rules or checks.
addons.benefit: Stops specs from rotting over time and turns every resolved bug or review finding into an automated guardrail.

addons.name: Antigravity Lifecycle Hooks
addons.sdlcRole: Injects active .sdlc/ context at session start, blocks destructive shell commands and secret writes, logs fast checks, and checks Proof completion on Stop.
addons.benefit: Provides automatic safety rails against accidental data loss, leaked credentials, and unverified task completion.

addons.name: Graphify CLI Engine (External)
addons.sdlcRole: Builds AST + semantic knowledge graphs (graphify-out/graph.json & GRAPH_REPORT.md) across code, docs, and diagrams.
addons.benefit: Powers fast graph queries, shortest paths, and community detection on medium/large repositories without loading whole trees.

addons.name: Elephant-Goldfish Model Plugin (Upstream)
addons.sdlcRole: Adds Google's full standalone EGM skill suite (/egm:egm-brainstorm, egm-draft, egm-review-loop, egm-drift-report) alongside Universal SDLC.
addons.benefit: Gives you multi-critic design review loops and full upstream EGM commands whenever deeper brainstorming is needed.

addons.name: ICM Architect Skill (Upstream)
addons.sdlcRole: Adds Jake Van Clief's standalone icm-architect skill for restructuring messy repos, knowledge vaults, or custom agent pipelines.
addons.benefit: Helps reorganize sprawling documentation or custom agent folders into clean walkable ICM structures beyond .sdlc/.

addons.name: Gitleaks Secret Scanner
addons.sdlcRole: Scans git history and working trees for leaked passwords, API tokens, and private keys during verify-profile runs.
addons.benefit: Catches historical or committed secrets across the repository before code leaves your workstation.

addons.name: Semgrep SAST Scanner
addons.sdlcRole: Runs fast multi-language static security analysis (XSS, SQLi, SSRF, insecure defaults) for web, API, mobile, and desktop profiles.
addons.benefit: Finds common vulnerability classes automatically across multiple languages using community and custom rules.

addons.name: Trivy Dependency & Container Scanner
addons.sdlcRole: Scans lockfiles, containers, and IaC configs for known CVEs and misconfigurations.
addons.benefit: Prevents shipping vulnerable third-party dependencies or insecure Docker/Kubernetes configurations.
